title: RiskRAG: A Data-Driven Solution for Improved AI Model Risk Reporting
reasoning: The paper focuses on the development and evaluation of a tool (RiskRAG) for automating AI model risk reporting. While the tool identifies and reports on ethical and social bias risks as categories of AI failure (e.g., representation harms), its primary research goal is the efficacy of the documentation system itself, rather than a dedicated benchmark or evaluation of religion, morals, or ethical reasoning.
